chunks: (The sinners) will be told: "Invoke your partners." They will call on them, but they will not answer; and they will see the torment (and wish) if only they had come to guidance.

key_terms.شُرَكَاءَكُمْ: Your partners (false deities associated with God)

ai.seo_question: What happens when the polytheists call upon their false gods on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ultimate futility of shirk, illustrating that false deities lack the power to intercede or alleviate divine punishment on the Day of Judgment. The scene serves as a profound lesson on accountability, emphasizing that the worshippers' own invocation of their idols will be their testimony against them, as the idols remain silent witnesses to their error.
